Stabilizer of e12 forces every equivariant cycle-valued map T to map e12 to vector a e12+bΣ_{k>2}(e1k−e2k), with a+(n−2)b=0. Edge transitivity and fixed action on Z force T=Q. All n≥3 covered including n=3; 59,831 exact rational checks corroborate finite cases.

value.rationale: Defines and exactly evaluates a nontrivial natural intrinsic relative Banach-space projection invariant of the complete-graph real signed cycle-flow subspace, whose dimension grows quadratically with n. Characterizes the precise norm-one exception n=3 and a sharp asymptotic obstruction tending to 3. The Lipschitz-free graph literature explicitly identifies the cycle-space projection constant as structurally important, whereas the general hyperplane and recursively constructed graph literature does not supply the complete-graph constant.
